about: Every illustration the Daily Review and Routines use (docs/routines-plan.md, docs/routines-art.md). Generated by hand in the Gemini app, saved into inbox/ as <id>.png, then imported. The prompt sheet is prototypes/routines-space/art.html. Kurenai's base is drawn from her redesign on the Mind sheet (art-source/mind/inbox/, batch 1–2 there), so make those first.

styles.colour: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (the tall woman in the white coat) exactly — high-quality modern anime illustration, light-novel cover quality, fine clean lineart with thin tapered lines, soft cel shading with gentle gradients, detailed fabric folds, rich but slightly muted colours, natural slender proportions, soft even studio lighting from the front-left. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.
styles.bg: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (painterly anime background art, as in a high-budget TV anime or visual novel): soft painted lighting, clean perspective, gentle depth of field. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.

rules: Never any text: no letters, no Japanese, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signatures, no logos. Signs, menus and posters are blank or show pictures only. (All text is added later as a live layer.)
Keep each character's design identical to their sheet: hair, eyes, uniform, colours.
Save each result into art-source/routines/inbox/ with the exact file name shown, as PNG at the highest resolution Gemini offers.

kurenai.name: 紅 (Kurenai)
kurenai.role: The calm friend who already knows your day: she greets each Daily Review and is pleased, never cross. Her redesign of 24 October 2026 (docs/mind-plan.md §19.1).
kurenai.look: a Japanese woman in her mid-twenties, calm, perceptive and gently amused; long straight black hair to the waist with a violet underlayer showing at the ends, soft side-swept bangs; one small crimson five-petal flower hair ornament on the right side of her head, with no tassel; rose-crimson eyes; a plain white knee-length lab coat worn open, its lining a muted crimson, sleeves turned back once at the cuffs, no patterns, no badges, no writing; under it a simple black high-collared knee-length dress with a single crimson button at the collar and no slit; black tights; black ankle boots with a low heel; holding a slim plain dark tablet; average height, natural proportions, a little shorter than the young man in the reference

batches.title: Kurenai's base pose
batches.why: One new full-body pose holding a mug, from her redesigned sheet and Mind base. Every expression is edited onto it, so the body never moves.

batches.title: Expressions
batches.why: Edits of the base: upload it to Gemini, then give the prompt. Only the face may change. One per review mood: morning, attentive (afternoon), evening, concerned (behind, never cross) and proud (a routine kept).

batches.title: Review backgrounds
batches.why: Behind each review's header: morning, afternoon, evening, and night for the wind-down. The right third stays calm for Kurenai and the text.

batches.title: Routine covers
batches.why: Small card art per template, picked by the routine's kind. Still lifes, so no character drift.

batches.title: Empty states
batches.why: Two spot illustrations on green, keyed out: all done for today, and a fresh start (first visit).

assets.prompt: Kurenai from the attached character sheet and base pose ({look:kurenai}), drawn as a visual-novel character sprite at exactly the same scale, proportions and rendering as the attached base pose. Change only the pose: standing facing the viewer, body turned very slightly to her right, holding a plain white mug of tea in both hands at chest height (no tablet), shoulders relaxed, a calm neutral expression with the mouth closed, eyes open looking at the viewer. Same outfit, hair and hair ornament as the sheet, nothing added. Centred, the whole figure visible from the top of the hair to the boots, with a small margin above the head and below the feet; nothing cropped. Background: one flat solid pure green colour (#00FF00), completely even, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no green anywhere on the subject.

Edit this image. Keep the exact same pose, body, hands, mug, clothing, hair, hair ornament, framing, size, position and the flat green background, pixel for pixel. Change ONLY the facial expression to: encouraging: a bright, warm open smile, eyebrows slightly raised, eyes lively, as if saying good morning. Do not move the head.

Edit this image. Keep the exact same pose, body, hands, mug, clothing, hair, hair ornament, framing, size, position and the flat green background, pixel for pixel. Change ONLY the facial expression to: attentive: a small focused look, lips gently closed, eyebrows level, eyes alert and kind, as if listening. Do not move the head.

Edit this image. Keep the exact same pose, body, hands, mug, clothing, hair, hair ornament, framing, size, position and the flat green background, pixel for pixel. Change ONLY the facial expression to: calm at night: a soft, slightly tired gentle smile, eyelids a little lowered, relaxed. Do not move the head.

Edit this image. Keep the exact same pose, body, hands, mug, clothing, hair, hair ornament, framing, size, position and the flat green background, pixel for pixel. Change ONLY the facial expression to: kindly concerned: eyebrows drawn slightly together and up, a small reassuring closed-mouth smile, never sad or disappointed. Do not move the head.

Edit this image. Keep the exact same pose, body, hands, mug, clothing, hair, hair ornament, framing, size, position and the flat green background, pixel for pixel. Change ONLY the facial expression to: quietly proud: a pleased closed-mouth smile with gently curved eyes and the head held a touch higher (the face only). Do not move the head.
